title: Model ML Partners with Quartr to Bring Qualitative Research Into Model ML
body_markdown:
We’re excited to announce that Model ML and[Quartr](https://quartr.com/) are partnering to bring Quartr’s leading data and tools for qualitative research to Model ML users.


Quartr is the AI research partner for finance professionals that helps them to catch the qualitative signals that move markets. Quartr’s data draws from first-party IR materials from over 16,000 public companies, across 65+ markets.


With access to Quartr, Model ML users can conduct even deeper qualitative research on the public companies that they cover in real time, without leaving the Model ML platform. Users can research faster, reduce noise, and focus on what matters.


Live now for all Model ML users with a Quartr license.
